federation.label: Federation
federation.description: Share personnel, released eNOTF protocols and fire incidents with other ignis instances (read-only). Connects to other servers.
settings.tab.federation.lead: Settings for federation with other ignis instances.
settings.federation.instance_name.label: Instance name
settings.federation.instance_name.hint: How partner instances see this instance. Empty = application name.
settings.federation.cache_days.label: Federation cache (days)
settings.federation.cache_days.hint: Foreign eNOTF protocols and incidents are deleted after this many days. 7 to 365.
settings.federation.instance_id.label: Instance ID
settings.federation.instance_id.hint: Identifier of this instance in the network. Created by the first invite or pairing.
federation.settings.title: Federation
federation.settings.lead: Pair other ignis instances and choose what is fetched and provided. Everything is read-only.
federation.settings.instance_id_none: created by the first invite or pairing
federation.settings.invite.title: Create invite
federation.settings.invite.lead: Creates a connection key for the other instance. It works once and for :minutes minutes; a new invite replaces the old one.
federation.settings.invite.once: Visible only now. Copy it and enter it at the other instance under “Paste key”.
federation.settings.invite.error: The invite could not be created.
federation.settings.pair.title: Paste key
federation.settings.pair.lead: Paste the connection key of another instance to pair both.
federation.settings.links.title: Connections
federation.settings.delete_confirm: Remove the connection to “:name”? The data fetched from this instance is deleted. The other instance has to remove its side itself.
federation.settings.sync_queued: Sync queued. The result shows after a reload.
federation.settings.paired: Instance paired. Now choose what is fetched and provided.
federation.error.http_403: The invite is invalid, expired or already used (or the data is not provided).
federation.error.http_404: The other instance has not switched federation on.
federation.error.http_409: The other instance is already paired with this one.
federation.error.http_429: Too many requests. Please try again later.
federation.error.self: This is this instance's own key.
federation.error.invalid_url: The other instance's address is invalid (https only).
federation.error.blocked_address: The other instance's address points to a blocked (private) network.
federation.error.tls: The other instance's certificate is invalid.
federation.error.redirect: The other instance redirects; redirects are not allowed.
federation.error.too_large: The other instance's answer is too large.
federation.error.bad_json: The other instance gave an invalid answer.
federation.error.peer_v1: The other instance still uses the old protocol and has to be migrated.
federation.error.clock_skew: The clocks of both servers differ too much (check NTP).
federation.error.unauthorized: The other instance does not know this connection (any more).
federation.views.protocols.title: eNOTF protocols in the federation
federation.views.incidents.title: Incidents in the federation
